overall_notes: The extraction was generally accurate. The paper focuses on gender-fair text rewriting using sequence-to-sequence models. Main contributions include Backward Augmentation and Round-trip Augmentation approaches for training data creation. Evaluation uses both automatic metrics (WER) and human evaluation (gender-fairness ratings). No LLMs are used as judges.
